name: Omarchy Widgets
author: CHDevSec
description: Desktop widgets that sit on the wallpaper, under your windows, drawn with Omarchy's own panels and theme: clock (pixel art too), calendar, system stats, notes (Obsidian too), week of meetings, Trello cards, weather, now playing and a world clock. Drag with a guided snapping grid, stretch, lock; right-click any widget for settings.
